notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.notes: [p]Over the last week, we have started to improve the in-game UI to enable new interactions with enemy robots. It will soon be possible to visualize the predicted movement of enemies![/p][p align="start"]I would like to take this opportunity to provide a brief overview of how the [i]Planning Phase[/i] works in Sync Tactics. This phase occurs simultaneously for all players (including the AI), meaning that each participant will plan their robots' actions at the same time as the others.[/p][p align="start"]While planning these actions seems straightforward enough, it is important to remember that, in the next phase ([i]Execution Phase[/i]), the robots will attempt to carry out these actions, but not all at once. Each robot will act in accordance with its turn order (the number displayed above each robot's health bar).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701472/6c811a0ccb241e1b511efd821d749da76c548d4b.gif"][/img][/p][p]In this example, the enemy robot has a turn order '2', while your robot has a turn order '3'. This means that, while you are trying to move closer to the enemy, it is extremely likely that the enemy will move away from that position before your robot can reach it.[/p][p align="start"]What are your options then?[/p][p align="start"]The most basic strategy is to select the enemy directly as the target for your movement action, and then target it also for your melee attack. This way, in the execution phase, your robot will try to reach the enemy, regardless of where it moved, and then attack it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701472/ee0df25789577bc759ee21e5ce13ffab6d59438d.gif"][/img][/p][p]There are also more advanced techniques involving different equipment. But if this seems confusing, don't worry! We're developing a system that will not only visualize the movement range of the enemies, but also move them to the position you think they are going to go, so that you can more easily visualize what is likely to happen and better plan your moves![/p]

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
[p]We have new capsule art!

Thanks to our 3D artist who patiently drew it entirely by hand! 
We don't use AI, as this process demonstrates:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701472/b49ca69666a063e72ca201fb8c8c47c3bce13654.png"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, the developers had been busy fixing bugs, improving the UI, and balancing the game.[/p][p align="start"]We also had an unexpected meeting with a publisher this week. We're going to prepare a build for them in a few days' time. Wish us luck![/p]

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes: [p]One of the most difficult aspects of having simultaneous turns is displaying the most important actions when multiple robots are executing at the same time.[/p][p]This week, the effort was focused on improving the automatic camera's ability to identify the right events to follow.[/p][p]What's more, we're finalizing the tutorial and tooltips to ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new players. Most of the mechanics are fairly straightforward to learn, and we're trying to keep the tutorial as short and concise as possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701472/0abd16cd1e965e5ee89e69731ec2f221643d016e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes: [p]This week we’ve been focusing on polishing the animations, especially the one that plays when a robot takes damage, it’s now more dynamic and should feel much more impactful during battles. [/p][p]On top of that, we’ve started testing the mobile version of the game to make sure everything runs smoothly on smaller screens and to test the cross-platform co-op mode. [/p][p]Exciting progress all around![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701472/884e1a908a45700eb4ad99c906c00917352f922e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[p]We're not slowing down the development, even during this hot summer.[/p][p]Over the past week, the team has been working to improve the UI quality, create new robot components and balance the initial campaign challenges. As always, there has also been a lot of bug-fixing,[/p][p]The changes here are quite noticeable!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701472/604361f50436ce15ffe6d6ea7e591b276886f883.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701472/f40755cb68607e966644ee10f1cca3edf2b9b43c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thank you for your interest in Sync Tactics!
notes.notes: [p]With this initial announcement, we aim to begin a series of regular updates highlighting our progress on Sync Tactics and our future plans.[/p][p]We will be fully transparent about the state of development and what we are working on before each release. Feel free to ask us any questions about the game, we will try to answer all your queries.[/p][p]Our next step is to release an initial alpha version on Itch.io. The game is already playable, including in co-op mode, but it needs much more playtesting and refinement before we can release a demo here on Steam.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more news![/p]
